title: BNCI 2014-008 P300 dataset (ALS patients)
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 8 patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) performing a P300-based brain-computer interface (BCI) speller task. Participants completed a copy-spelling paradigm using a 6×6 matrix with row-column intensification, generating 35 trials per subject across a single session. The preprocessed data, acquired at 256 Hz from 8 electrodes using active g.Ladybird sensors, demonstrates high classification accuracy (97.5%) and serves as a benchmark for evaluating BCI performance in clinical populations with severe motor impairment.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 256 Hz sampling rate from 8 active electrodes (Fz, Cz, Pz, Oz, P3, P4, PO7, PO8) using g.MOBILAB hardware and BCI2000 software. Online filtering included 0.1-10 Hz bandpass and 50 Hz notch filters. Preprocessing involved offline bandpass filtering (0.1-10 Hz, 4th-order Butterworth), notch filtering at 50 Hz, artifact rejection (amplitude threshold ±70 μV), and baseline correction using 200 ms pre-stimulus intervals. Data were re-referenced to the right earlobe with ground at left mastoid.
